Trigger: Multi-tenant RAG system retrieves embeddings without filtering by user_id/tenant_id.
Impact: User A sees User B's HR records or financial statements.
Detection Mechanism: Audit logs show user_id accessing doc_id not belonging to their group.
Prevention Control: Enforce RBAC at Storage; Query Filtering
Incident Response: Revoke tokens; Purge cache; Notify users

Trigger: User prompts model with specific name/entity and model recalls training data.
Impact: Exposure of PII, internal code snippets, or API keys.
Detection Mechanism: Statistical Canary tests; Regex scanning on output.
Prevention Control: Data Sanitization before training; Differential Privacy

Trigger: User sends prompts to ignore instructions and adopt unrestricted persona.
Impact: AI performs unauthorized actions or reveals internal logic.
Detection Mechanism: Input analysis for semantic similarity to known jailbreak patterns.
Incident Response: Block session; Add pattern to blocklist

Trigger: User asks to print system instructions verbatim.
Impact: Competitors steal prompt engineering; Exposure of backend API schema.
Detection Mechanism: Output length anomalies; specific keywords in output.
Incident Response: Rotate API keys; Update prompt logic

Trigger: User asks for data, AI invents realistic but wrong internal data.
Impact: Business decisions made on false data; Reputational damage.
Detection Mechanism: Grounding check (compare output vs retrieved chunks).

Trigger: Attacker queries model to infer membership of specific data points.
Impact: Confirming individual data existence in private dataset.
Detection Mechanism: High-frequency queries of similar semantic variance from single IP.

Trigger: App logs user prompts (PII) and responses to Datadog/Splunk in plain text.
Impact: DevOps engineers can read private conversations/passwords.
Detection Mechanism: Log scanning (DLP tools) finding PII patterns.

Trigger: Production error returns full Stack Trace or internal states.
Impact: Exposure of file paths, library versions, and logic flow.
Detection Mechanism: Response status 500 contains keywords like Traceback.

Trigger: AI summarizes content with hidden malicious instructions.
Detection Mechanism: Outbound traffic analysis to unauthorized URLs.

Trigger: AI Agent sends full history to unnecessary plugins.
Impact: Third-party provider receives sensitive user context.
Detection Mechanism: Audit plugin payloads size and content.
Prevention Control: Principle of Least Privilege; Approved Allowlist
